# iOS HIG (Modern) Theme Showcase

Welcome to the **iOS HIG** (Modern) theme showcase for MemWault. This is the default, highly polished modern interface built around Apple's Human Interface Guidelines, featuring fluid animations, spring physics, and heavy use of translucency.

## Dashboard Overview

A clean, card-based interface with large typography and dynamic widgets.

![Dashboard Home](../../screenshots/dashboard_home.jpg)

## Memories & Timeline (Semantic Zoom)

The core feature of the iOS theme is the fluid semantic zoom timeline. Transition smoothly between Years, Months, and Days views using Framer Motion spring-based animations.

![Memories Timeline](../../screenshots/memories_month_view.jpg)
*[PLACEHOLDER: Add new screenshot of the timeline with the FastScrollbar]*

## Memory Studio & Posts Tab

The Memory Studio lets you inspect media, metadata, and journal entries. The new **Posts Tab** extends this to multi-slide Instagram carousels and videos.

![Story Detail Editor](../../screenshots/memory_journal_tab.jpg)
*[PLACEHOLDER: Add new screenshot of a Carousel Post Detail in iOS Theme]*

## Mobile QR Upload Portal

A massive addition to the modern theme is the ability to stream uncompressed full-resolution RAW photos and Live Photos directly from your smartphone to your PC desktop vault via local Wi-Fi.

Explore your memories geographically on an interactive Leaflet map featuring spatial clustering and bounding-box search.
